summary.intent: Plan and begin executing Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) in the CipherBox monorepo — a major architectural change replacing legacy metadata types with unified Node types featuring dual-sealed bodies and generation-based AAD.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (9 plans / 7 waves, all gates passed after 1 revision round), artifacts committed. Execution was initiated but the transcript ends before Wave 1 begins.

repo: Consumer test files that import deleted types fail tsc BEFORE `describe.skip` evaluates — imports must be removed entirely, not just test bodies skipped.
vault v3 = v2 pattern applied twice across 3 files atomically; ~30 consumer files need only import-swap + stub (mechanical but broad blast radius).
The gsd commit helper false-negatives: reports `commit_failed` even when the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log` before retrying.
Nyquist validation gate requires a `## Validation Architecture` section in RESEARCH.md to auto-generate VALIDATION.md; without research, Dimension-8 validation requirements are absent from plans.
PATTERNS.md is a known commit gap: workflow step 13d commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP but not PATTERNS.md — must be committed explicitly.
Drift precheck fires on pre-existing stale baseline elements (flagged 143 elements from Feb .learnings/, landing/, root configs), not Phase 62-specific changes — non-blocking and noisy.
schema-gate hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase); `registry/schema.ts` and `bin/types.ts` in packages/core are not ORM schemas — gate skip is safe.
Cross-package dist chain is core→sdk-core→sdk→web; plans must respect this compile-gate dependency order.
Plan size threshold exists (~43 files triggers a split recommendation); Plan 08 was split into 08a/08b across waves 6 and 7.
`workflow.auto_advance: true` in config would chain straight into execute-phase after planning — use `--no-transition` to stop at phase boundary for human review.

code.finding: Identified as the seal primitive analog for sealNode/unsealNode implementation.
Vault v3 blob implementation; pattern: v2 applied twice, 3-file atomic change.
New file created to hold frozen vault v3 golden vectors (committed file, not inline in plan) for cross-language parity validation.
JSON codec analog for the new node encode/decode codec — mirrors encryptFolderMetadata pattern.

workflow: Sequential execution beats parallel worktrees in a pnpm monorepo: worktrees lack node_modules (slow per-worktree pnpm i) and cross-package dist chains are simpler on one tree.
Plan-checker runs on a 15-dimension framework; expect 1 revision round for complex phases. Blockers tend to be gate hygiene (RESOLVED markers, exit-code-safe verifies) rather than structural flaws.
API surface intel that extracts 0 symbols is noise — omit it from planner prompts rather than injecting an empty block.
Worktree degradation to sequential can be avoided by setting `baseref-head` in config, which pins the fork base to live HEAD.
Post-planning gap analysis (step 13e) is a no-op when no `plan:post` hooks are active — skip it rather than blocking on it.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative on VALIDATION.md commit: reported `commit_failed` but `git log` confirmed the commit landed (`2475ae35d`). Requires manual verification after every commit.
Node eval quoting bug in bash when parsing worktree/degrade config — required a manual re-extraction pass.
Requirements-coverage display glitch: word-splitting printed all six NODE IDs as one token, requiring a clean re-run to confirm the gate passed.
Drift precheck fires on 143 stale baseline elements with no filtering for phase-relevant changes — high noise, low signal.
Researcher and planner agent-skills blocks were both empty, adding a fetch step with no payoff.
ROADMAP annotation via `gsd-tools` was a no-op (idempotent, returned `updated: false`) because the planner revision had already set wave structure — but the tool call still had to be made.
open_items: Phase 62 execution not yet started — transcript ends before Wave 1 begins; all 9 plans across 7 waves remain to be executed.
Stale codebase baseline map: `/gsd-map-codebase` should be run to refresh it and eliminate drift precheck noise on future phases.
PATTERNS.md commit gap is a known workflow bug in step 13d — should be upstreamed as a fix to the execute-phase workflow.
Decision D-02 final gate (root `pnpm typecheck`) lives in Plan 08b (Wave 7) — only passes after all 8 prior plans complete successfully.
~30 consumer stub plans (sdk-core/sdk/web) are scoped to phases 63–66 — Phase 62 only validates compile-gates, not stub behavior.
